title: Ohms, Watts and Volts in Vaping: A Beginner's Explanation
summary: Resistance, power and voltage control how a coil performs. This guide explains them without the math headache.
body:
You do not need an engineering degree, but a little electrical knowledge helps you choose hardware and settings.

## Ohms: resistance
Ohms (Ω) measure how much a coil resists current. Low-resistance coils draw more current and heat faster. High-resistance coils heat more gently.

## Watts: power
Watts (W) measure the power the device sends to the coil. More watts means more heat, more vapor and faster liquid use. Every coil has a recommended wattage range, and staying within it protects both flavor and lifespan.

## Volts: electrical pressure
Volts (V) describe the electrical pressure. Some devices let you set voltage rather than watts.

## How they relate
Power equals voltage squared divided by resistance. In practice, you pick a coil with a resistance suited to your style and set the wattage within its range.

## Typical ranges
- **MTL coils:** about 1 ohm or higher, at lower wattage.
- **Sub-ohm coils:** below 1 ohm, at higher wattage.
See [sub-ohm versus mouth-to-lung](/blog/sub-ohm-vs-mouth-to-lung/).

## Start low
Begin at the lower end of the recommended range and increase gradually. If the vapor tastes harsh or burnt, lower the power.

## Care
Use the right battery for high-power setups; see [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/). Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: What wattage should I use?
faq.a: Use the range printed on the coil, starting near the bottom.

faq.q: Do disposables have adjustable wattage?
faq.a: Almost never. Power is set by the manufacturer, sometimes with a boost mode.

title: What Is in E-Liquid? PG, VG, Flavoring and Nicotine Explained
summary: E-liquid has four main components. Learn what each one does, what to look for on a label and what is meant by food-grade flavoring.
body:
E-liquid is a short list of ingredients, though the details differ between brands.

## Propylene glycol (PG)
A thin, odorless liquid that carries flavor and gives throat feel. It is used widely in food and personal care products.

## Vegetable glycerin (VG)
A thicker, slightly sweet liquid made from plant oils, which produces denser vapor.

## Flavoring
Flavor concentrates give each liquid its character. Brands describe them as food-grade, meaning they are commonly used in foods, though being edible is not the same as being suitable to inhale. We make no health claims about flavorings.

## Nicotine
Present in most liquids, as freebase or nicotine salts, in a stated strength. Nicotine is addictive. See the [nicotine strength guide](/blog/nicotine-strength-guide/).

## Optional extras
Some liquids add cooling agents, sweeteners or water. Not all are listed in detail, so check the brand's information.

## Reading the label
Look for ratios, strength, volume and the warning statement. Our guide to [reading an e-liquid label](/blog/how-to-read-an-e-liquid-label/) walks through each element.

## Storage
Keep liquid cool, dark and away from children and pets; see [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Allergies
If you suspect a reaction to an ingredient, stop using the product and talk to a healthcare professional.

## Shop
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Are all e-liquids made the same way?
faq.a: They share a base of PG and VG, but flavor systems and extras differ between brands.

faq.q: Is PG or VG an allergen?
faq.a: Some people are sensitive to them. If you notice irritation, stop using the product.

title: What Is Steeping, and Does It Matter for E-Liquid?
summary: Steeping lets flavors blend over days or weeks. Learn when it helps, when it does not and how to do it properly.
body:
Steeping is the practice of letting e-liquid rest, usually in a cool dark place, so flavors blend and mellow.

## Why people steep
Fresh mixed liquid can taste sharp or uneven. Over time, flavor molecules disperse and the nicotine mellows, which can make the liquid taste rounder.

## Which liquids benefit
- **Dessert and custard recipes** often improve with a week or two.
- **Tobacco flavors** often benefit from longer.
- **Fruit and menthol** recipes usually taste good fresh and need less.

## Do commercial liquids need it
Most commercial liquids are ready to use, and many brands steep before bottling. A few extra days rarely hurts, but it is not required.

## How to steep
1. Cap the bottle tightly.
2. Shake it, then open the cap briefly to release air.
3. Store it in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight.
4. Shake occasionally and wait several days.

## What to avoid
Do not store liquid in a hot car or window sill, and do not leave caps loose. Heat and light can darken liquid and change flavor. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Dark color is normal
Nicotine liquid darkens with time and oxygen. A little color change is usual.

## Shop
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/), or read about [bottle sizes](/blog/e-liquid-bottle-sizes-30ml-60ml-100ml/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How long should I steep?
faq.a: Many liquids are fine immediately. Dessert and tobacco profiles often taste better after a week or two.

faq.q: Does steeping change nicotine strength?
faq.a: No. It changes how the liquid tastes and feels, not its labeled strength.

title: What Is Throat Hit, and What Affects It?
summary: Throat hit is the sensation vapor creates in your throat. See what increases or softens it, from nicotine type to PG ratio and temperature.
body:
Throat hit is the feeling of vapor at the back of the throat when you inhale. It is a major part of why people choose certain liquids and devices.

## What creates it
- **Nicotine strength:** higher strength gives a stronger sensation.
- **Nicotine type:** freebase feels sharper; salts feel smoother. See [salts versus freebase](/blog/nicotine-salts-vs-freebase/).
- **PG content:** high-PG liquids feel crisper than high-VG ones.
- **Temperature:** hotter vapor feels harsher.
- **Airflow:** tighter airflow concentrates the sensation.

## Cooling agents
Menthol-type cooling can add a sensation distinct from nicotine throat hit. Read about [ice flavors](/blog/ice-vape-flavors-guide/).

## How to soften it
- Lower the strength.
- Choose a higher-VG liquid.
- Open the airflow or lower the wattage.
- Try nicotine salts if you want a smooth feel at higher strength.

## How to increase it
Choose a higher PG ratio, tighter airflow or a slightly higher strength, within what is comfortable. Nicotine is addictive, and increasing intake is not advisable for everyone.

## Everyone is different
There is no right level. Experiment sensibly and stop if you feel unwell.

## Related
See [PG and VG](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/) and [adjustable airflow](/blog/adjustable-airflow-explained/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is stronger throat hit better?
faq.a: It is a preference, not a measure of quality.

faq.q: Why do salts feel smooth at high strength?
faq.a: The acid in the salt changes how nicotine is delivered, which softens the sensation.

title: How Cooling 'Ice' Flavors Work (and Who Likes Them)
summary: Ice versions add a chill to fruit and candy flavors. Learn what creates the sensation, how strong it can be and how to pick the right level.
body:
Many flavor names include "ice", "freeze" or "chill". These versions add a cooling sensation to the original flavor.

## What creates the cooling
Cooling comes from compounds that trigger the cold-sensing receptors in your mouth and throat, similar to the effect of mint. They do not change the temperature of the vapor; they change how it feels.

## Levels of cooling
Some recipes add a light cool finish, while others are a strong, icy blast. Names like "extra ice" usually signal more.

## Why people like it
Cooling can brighten fruit flavors and make sweeter profiles feel fresher. Some find it also softens the heat of vapor.

## Who may prefer no ice
If you are sensitive to menthol or find cooling harsh, choose a non-ice version. Our [ice flavors guide](/blog/ice-vape-flavors-guide/) lists options.

## How to compare
Try the same flavor with and without ice to learn your preference. Rotating can also keep flavors interesting; see [best disposables for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/).

## Impact on hardware
Cooling agents can leave residue on coils over time. Keep to the recommended power and replace parts on schedule; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Does ice mean menthol?
faq.a: Often it means a menthol-type cooling agent, though recipes vary.

faq.q: Can I get a cooling flavor without mint?
faq.a: Yes. Many fruit-and-ice flavors use cooling without a strong mint taste.

title: A Short History of Vaping: From Early Patents to Pod Systems
summary: Electronic cigarettes have evolved over decades, from early patents to cig-a-likes, tanks, box mods and today's pods and disposables.
body:
Modern vaping has a surprisingly long backstory. Here is a short timeline of how devices developed.

## Early ideas
Patents for smokeless electronic devices appeared in the 1960s, but the concept did not reach consumers at the time.

## The first commercial e-cigarette
In 2003, a Chinese pharmacist named Hon Lik designed a modern electronic cigarette that used an ultrasonic atomizer. Commercial products reached the market in the mid-2000s and spread to Europe and the United States.

## Cig-a-likes
First-generation devices looked like cigarettes and used small batteries and cartomizers. They were simple but limited in battery life and vapor.

## Tanks and box mods
Around 2010, refillable tanks and larger battery devices let users customize power, airflow and flavor. Sub-ohm vaping emerged, producing larger vapor clouds.

## The pod era
Compact, easy pod systems appeared in the mid-2010s, using nicotine salts to deliver smoother, stronger hits from low-power hardware.

## Disposables
Pre-filled disposables grew in popularity because they need no setup. Recent models include mesh coils, rechargeable batteries and screens. See [how to choose a disposable](/blog/how-to-choose-a-disposable-vape/).

## Regulation
Governments have steadily regulated vaping, from age limits to the [PACT Act](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) and FDA oversight. See [FDA and vaping products](/blog/fda-and-vaping-products-what-adults-should-know/).

## Today
Hardware is more compact and easier than ever. Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) to see current options. Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Who invented the modern e-cigarette?
faq.a: Hon Lik, a Chinese pharmacist, designed a modern electronic cigarette in 2003.

faq.q: Why did pods become popular?
faq.a: They are small, simple and work well with nicotine salts.

title: Vapes, Pouches and Other Nicotine Products: How They Differ
summary: A neutral comparison of how vapes and nicotine pouches work, what each requires and what adults should consider before using them.
body:
Nicotine products come in several forms. This overview describes how they differ in use, without health claims or recommendations.

## Vapes
A vape heats liquid to create vapor that you inhale. They need a charged battery, and refillable ones need liquid and coils. See [how a vape works](/blog/how-does-a-vape-work/).

## Nicotine pouches
Pouches are small tobacco-free pouches placed between the lip and gum. Nicotine is absorbed in the mouth, and there is no vapor, device or charging. See [pouches for beginners](/blog/nicotine-pouches-beginners-guide/).

## Practical differences
- **Equipment:** vapes need hardware; pouches need none.
- **Discretion:** pouches produce no vapor.
- **Cost:** vary by brand and use.
- **Rules:** laws for vaping and pouches differ by place.

## What they have in common
All contain nicotine, which is addictive, and are for adults 21 and over. None come without risks, and we make no health claims.

## Choosing
Think about where you will use it, how much effort you want to spend and local rules. Many adults try one form and stay with it.

## Browse
See [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Read [state and local vape laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Not medical advice
If you want advice on nicotine use, consult a healthcare professional. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Do pouches contain tobacco?
faq.a: Modern pouches are described as tobacco-free, though they contain nicotine.

faq.q: Which one is right for me?
faq.a: That depends on your preferences and local rules. Neither comes without risk.

title: What Is a Box Mod? Features, Benefits and Who Needs One
summary: Box mods are larger, adjustable devices for experienced users. Learn what they offer over pods and what to know before buying one.
body:
A box mod is a battery-powered device that holds one or more batteries and powers a separate tank. They are the larger, more adjustable end of vape hardware.

## What makes them different
Box mods offer adjustable wattage, temperature or voltage settings, bigger batteries and compatibility with many tanks via a 510 thread. Many include a screen and menu.

## Benefits
- **Power range:** support for sub-ohm tanks and big vapor.
- **Battery life:** larger cells last longer.
- **Customization:** swap tanks and coils to suit your taste.

## Drawbacks
- **Size and weight:** bulkier than pods.
- **Complexity:** more settings and more to learn.
- **Safety considerations:** removable batteries need correct handling. See [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Who should consider one
Experienced adult vapers who want to tune their device and use high-power tanks. Beginners are usually better served by pods; see [disposable vs pod vs box mod](/blog/disposable-vs-pod-vs-box-mod/).

## Coils and liquid
Pair a box mod with a sub-ohm tank and a lower-strength, higher-VG liquid. See [PG and VG ratios](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/) and [ohms, watts and volts](/blog/what-are-ohms-watts-and-volts-in-vaping/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Do box mods need special batteries?
faq.a: Many use removable 18650 or 21700 cells. Use cells rated for the device and never mix them.

faq.q: Can a beginner use a box mod?
faq.a: Possible, but a simpler pod kit is usually easier to start with.

title: E-Liquid Shelf Life: How Long Does It Last?
summary: Unopened e-liquid usually lasts a year or two when stored well. See what shortens shelf life and how to tell when liquid has gone off.
body:
E-liquid does not last forever, but with good storage it stays usable for a long time.

## Typical shelf life
Most bottles carry a best-by date about one to two years after manufacture. Unopened liquid stored properly generally stays fine until then.

## What shortens it
- **Heat:** warm places accelerate chemical changes.
- **Light:** sunlight darkens liquid and degrades flavor.
- **Air:** every opening introduces oxygen. Keep caps tight.
- **Contamination:** dirty tips or fingers.

## Signs of aging
Liquid darkens, flavor weakens, or it smells or tastes off. Darkening alone is usual with nicotine, but a sour or flat taste means it is past its best.

## Nicotine and flavor
Nicotine slowly oxidizes, which changes color. Flavors, especially delicate fruits, can fade over time.

## How to extend life
Store in a cool, dark place, such as a drawer. Keep it upright, and tighten the cap after use. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Buying in bulk
Only buy more than you will use before the date. See [bottle sizes](/blog/e-liquid-bottle-sizes-30ml-60ml-100ml/).

## What to do with old liquid
Dispose of expired or off-tasting liquid responsibly; see [disposal guidance](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Shop
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Does darkened liquid mean it is bad?
faq.a: Not always. Nicotine liquids darken over time, but check the smell and taste as well.

faq.q: Can I freeze e-liquid?
faq.a: Cold storage is possible for long periods, but let it return to room temperature before use.

title: Cloud Chasing vs Flavor Chasing: Two Ways to Vape
summary: Some adults want big vapor, others want the best taste. Compare the hardware and settings for each style.
body:
Vapers tend to favor either large vapor clouds or concentrated flavor. The hardware and settings differ for each.

## Cloud chasing
Cloud chasers want dense, voluminous vapor. They use sub-ohm tanks, high wattage, open airflow and high-VG liquid at low nicotine strength. The draw is direct-to-lung. This style uses a lot of liquid and battery.

## Flavor chasing
Flavor chasers want the taste of the liquid at its best. They use smaller coils, moderate power, tighter airflow and balanced PG/VG liquids. Mouth-to-lung and restricted direct-to-lung setups are common.

## Hardware choices
- **Clouds:** box mod, large sub-ohm tank, high-VG liquid.
- **Flavor:** a flavor-focused tank or pod with mesh coils.
See [sub-ohm versus mouth-to-lung](/blog/sub-ohm-vs-mouth-to-lung/) and [adjustable airflow](/blog/adjustable-airflow-explained/).

## Nicotine
Cloud setups use low strength because each puff delivers a lot. Flavor setups use moderate strengths. See the [nicotine strength guide](/blog/nicotine-strength-guide/).

## Costs
Cloud chasing consumes much more liquid. Flavor setups are more economical.

## Consider etiquette
Large clouds in public can bother others and may break local rules. See [state and local laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Which style is cheaper?
faq.a: Flavor-focused setups usually use far less liquid.

faq.q: Can one device do both?
faq.a: Adjustable airflow devices can lean either way within limits.

title: Vape Indicator Lights: What Blinking and Color Changes Mean
summary: LED lights tell you about charge, faults and activation. Learn the common patterns and what to do when a vape blinks at you.
body:
Many devices use an LED instead of a screen. Patterns differ between makers, so check your manual, but several signals are common.

## Charging
A light while plugged in usually shows charging, changing color or turning off when full. On many devices a red light means charging and green or off means done.

## Low battery
Blinking when you inhale often means the battery is low. Charge the device if it is rechargeable. Non-rechargeable devices that blink at the end of life are done.

## Fault or protection mode
Rapid blinking can mean a short circuit, overheating or a coil problem. Stop using it and let it cool. If it continues, it may need replacement. See [how to fix a vape that will not charge](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/).

## Activation
A light that flashes when you draw is normal, indicating it is firing. A fast blink on press may be a lock or cut-off.

## Modes
Devices with power modes use colors to show the mode. Check the product description.

## When the light does nothing
No light and no vapor could mean a flat battery or an empty device. See [why my vape is not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/).

## Know your device
Keep the packaging or product page. Compare options in [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) that note light and screen features. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Why does my vape blink when I inhale?
faq.a: It can mean low battery, a fault or a protection feature. Check your manual.

faq.q: Is a charging light always red?
faq.a: No. Colors vary by manufacturer.

title: Auto-Draw vs Button-Fire: Which Activation Style Is Better?
summary: Some vapes fire when you inhale, others when you press a button. Compare control, convenience and typical use for each style.
body:
The way a device turns on affects how it feels and what it suits.

## Auto-draw (inhale-activated)
A sensor detects airflow and fires the coil as you draw. It is simple and intuitive. Almost all disposables and many pod systems work this way. Downsides: accidental activation if you squeeze the device, and less control over timing.

## Button-fire
You press a button to activate the coil before or while inhaling. It gives you control over when the coil heats and prevents accidental firing. Box mods and many pod kits offer it. The downside is an extra action with each puff.

## Some devices do both
A few pod kits support both modes, letting you choose.

## Which suits you
- **Simplicity:** auto-draw.
- **Control:** button-fire.
- **Travel:** button-fire, if it has a lock, reduces accidental firing in a bag.

## Considerations
Auto-draw sensors can be sensitive to blocked airflow. Keep air holes clear. See [vape not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/) for related fixes.

## Choosing hardware
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), and read [disposable vs pod vs box mod](/blog/disposable-vs-pod-vs-box-mod/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Is auto-draw more convenient?
faq.a: Yes, because you just inhale. The trade-off is less control.

faq.q: Can button-fire prevent leaks?
faq.a: It can reduce accidental firing, which helps in bags.

title: Types of Vaporizers Explained: Pens, Portables and Desktop Units
summary: Vaporizers come in several designs. Compare pens, portables and desktop units so you can see which style fits how you plan to use one.
body:
The word "vaporizer" covers a range of devices that heat material or liquid without burning. Here are the main types.

## Vape pens
Slim, battery-powered pens heat a cartridge or a small chamber. They are discreet and easy to carry, and are suited to people who want simplicity.

## Portable vaporizers
Larger handheld devices have a heating chamber, adjustable temperature and bigger batteries. They give more control than a pen at the cost of size.

## Desktop vaporizers
Plug-in units are designed for home use. They offer precise temperature control and excellent consistency but are not portable.

## Dab and concentrate devices
Some vaporizers are designed for concentrates with specific heating elements. These are specialist products, and their legality depends on your local laws.

## Choosing
Consider portability, battery life, how easy it is to clean and the cost of replacement parts. Read reviews and manuals, and buy from a reputable seller. See [how to buy a vaporizer wisely](/shop/vaporizers/).

## Legal considerations
Products and uses are regulated differently by state, and some materials remain restricted or illegal in places. Check [state and local laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Care
Clean regularly and handle batteries carefully; see [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Browse
See our [vaporizers](/shop/vaporizers/) category. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is a vaporizer the same as a vape?
faq.a: They overlap. 'Vaporizer' often refers to devices that heat material or concentrates, while 'vape' often means e-liquid devices.

faq.q: Are vaporizers legal everywhere?
faq.a: Rules vary. Check your local laws before buying.

title: Vape Flavor Profiles Explained: Fruit, Dessert, Menthol and Tobacco
summary: Understand the main flavor families so you can find what suits you, from bright fruit to rich dessert and classic tobacco.
body:
Flavor names can be confusing, but most vapes fall into a handful of families.

## Fruit
The biggest group. It includes single fruits like watermelon, mango and peach and blends like berry mixes and tropical punches. Fruit flavors are bright, sweet and often tart. Our flavor guides cover [watermelon](/blog/watermelon-vape-flavors-guide/) and [blue razz](/blog/blue-razz-vape-flavors-guide/).

## Menthol and mint
Cooling, crisp flavors. Mint is herbal and sweet, menthol is sharper and cooler. Some recipes mix them with fruit.

## Dessert and bakery
Creamy, sweet and rich: custards, pastries, cakes and ice cream. They tend to have dense vapor and can leave residue on coils.

## Tobacco
Earthy, nutty or smoky profiles that aim to mimic traditional tobacco, from light to robust.

## Beverage
Cola, lemonade, coffee and tea flavors, often with citrus or cooling notes.

## Candy
Cotton candy, gummy and sour flavors. They are very sweet and popular with those who like bold taste.

## Choosing a flavor
Start with a family you like in food or drink. If you want a chill, try an [ice flavor](/blog/ice-vape-flavors-guide/). Read [best disposables for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/).

## Browse
See [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Which flavor is most popular?
faq.a: Fruit blends and ice versions are among the best sellers, but tastes vary.

faq.q: Do dessert flavors damage coils faster?
faq.a: Sweet, creamy liquids tend to leave more residue, which can shorten coil life.

title: Why Is My Vape Not Hitting? 8 Causes and Quick Fixes
summary: No vapor or a weak draw is usually a simple fix. Work through these eight checks before assuming the device is dead.
body:
When a vape stops producing vapor, the cause is often easy to find. Check these in order.

## 1. Battery
A flat battery is the most common cause. Charge a rechargeable device for 20 to 30 minutes. See [how to charge a disposable](/blog/how-to-charge-a-disposable/) and [indicator lights](/blog/understanding-vape-device-indicator-lights/).

## 2. Out of liquid
Check the window or pod. A dry wick burns and gives weak or harsh vapor. Refill or replace.

## 3. Blocked airflow
Airflow holes can be covered by fingers or lint. Clean them gently.

## 4. Loose connection
Make sure the pod or tank is seated firmly and the contacts are clean. Wipe with a dry cotton bud.

## 5. Flooded coil
Too much liquid can drown the coil. Blow gently through the mouthpiece, wipe excess and wait a few minutes. See [fixing a gurgling vape](/blog/vape-gurgling-sound-fix/).

## 6. Worn coil
Coils lose performance with time. Replace it; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## 7. Cold or hot temperatures
Batteries struggle in cold. Warm the device in your hand, away from heat sources.

## 8. Device lock
Some devices lock after multiple clicks. Check the manual for the unlock sequence.

## Still nothing?
Disposables cannot be repaired. If your device is faulty, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID; see the [refund policy](/refunds/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How long should I charge a vape?
faq.a: Most rechargeable devices need about 30 minutes to an hour for a full charge. Check the manual.

faq.q: Can I fix a dead disposable?
faq.a: Not reliably. If it has no charging port or is faulty, replacement is the usual option.

title: Why Does My Vape Taste Burnt? Causes and Fixes
summary: A burnt taste usually means a dry or worn coil. Learn the causes, how to fix them and how to prevent it next time.
body:
A burnt taste is unpleasant and a clear sign that something is off. The usual culprits are listed here.

## Dry or low liquid
If liquid runs low, the wick dries and burns. Refill or replace before the pod empties.

## An unprimed coil
A new coil needs time to soak. Without priming, the dry cotton scorches on the first puffs. See [how to prime a coil](/blog/how-to-prime-a-new-coil-or-pod/).

## Chain vaping
Rapid puffs without letting the wick re-saturate can burn it. Take breaks between puffs.

## Wrong liquid for the coil
Thick, sugary or high-VG liquid can struggle to wick through small coils, and sweeteners caramelize on the heating surface. Match liquid to hardware; see [PG and VG ratios](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).

## Too much power
Running above the coil's recommended wattage burns cotton fast. Lower the setting.

## A worn coil
Coils that have been in use a while build up residue. Replace it. See [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## What not to do
Do not keep vaping through a burnt taste. It will not improve and can be unpleasant to inhale.

## Prevention
Prime coils, keep pods filled and use compatible liquid. Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/) for replacements. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can a burnt coil recover?
faq.a: Usually not. Replace it.

faq.q: Why do sweet liquids burn coils faster?
faq.a: Sugars and sweeteners can caramelize and leave residue on the heating element.

title: Vape Leaking? Common Causes and How to Stop It
summary: Leaks come from overfilling, loose seals, pressure changes or damaged parts. Find the cause and fix it with these steps.
body:
A leaking vape is messy and wasteful. The cause is usually one of these.

## Overfilling
Filling a pod or tank to the very top leaves no room for air. Fill below the max line and never over the central tube.

## Loose or damaged seals
Check that the pod or tank is tightly seated and that silicone seals are in place and not cracked.

## Cracked tank or pod
Inspect for hairline cracks, especially after a drop. Replace damaged parts.

## Pressure changes
Flights and driving through mountains can push liquid out. Keep pods nearly empty when traveling. See [vape for travel](/blog/best-vapes-for-travel/).

## Wrong liquid thickness
Thin liquid in a large-coil tank can seep. Thick liquid can cause flooding. See [PG and VG](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).

## Too much airflow
Very open airflow with a tight coil can cause condensation to pool.

## Worn coil
An old coil can flood. Replace it; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## Storage position
Store pods and tanks upright.

## Clean up
Wipe with a paper towel, wash hands and dispose of towels. Keep liquid away from children and pets; see [storage tips](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/).

## Replace
Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Why does my pod leak in my bag?
faq.a: Pressure and temperature changes push liquid out, so keep pods upright and nearly empty when traveling.

faq.q: Is leaked liquid harmful on skin?
faq.a: Wash it off promptly. Nicotine liquid can be absorbed through skin.

title: Gurgling Sound in Your Vape: Why It Happens and How to Fix It
summary: A gurgling vape usually has liquid in the airflow path. Clear it with these steps and avoid it in future.
body:
If your vape sounds like a straw at the bottom of a drink, liquid is where it should not be.

## Why it gurgles
Excess liquid has pooled in the airflow channel or around the coil, often from overfilling, a flooded coil or a faulty seal.

## Fix it step by step
1. Remove the pod or tank and wipe the outside.
2. Blow gently through the mouthpiece with the coil facing down, so excess liquid drains.
3. Wipe the contacts and the airflow holes with a dry cotton bud.
4. Let it sit upright for several minutes before using it again.
5. Take a few dry puffs without pressing the button if your device allows.

## Prevent it
- Do not overfill.
- Avoid very thin liquid in large-coil tanks.
- Open airflow slightly if it keeps happening.
- Keep devices upright when not in use.

## Worn parts
A cracked pod, damaged seal or worn coil can cause recurrent flooding. Replace them. See [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/) and [leaks and fixes](/blog/vape-leaking-causes-and-fixes/).

## Disposables
Gurgling in a disposable usually means condensation. Hold it upright for a minute and draw gently.

## Replace
Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is gurgling dangerous?
faq.a: It is a nuisance, but check for leaks and avoid inhaling liquid. Clear it before using the device.

faq.q: Can I keep using a gurgling vape?
faq.a: Clear it first. Liquid in the airflow path can cause spitting.

title: Vape Won't Charge? Troubleshooting Steps That Work
summary: If your device does not charge, the cable, port or battery may be the cause. Try these checks before replacing the device.
body:
A vape that refuses to charge is frustrating, but several issues are easy to fix.

## 1. Try another cable
Cables fail more often than devices. Test a different USB-C or micro-USB cable known to work.

## 2. Try another power source
Use a standard 5V adapter or a different USB port. Some chargers that deliver high-power fast charging may not work with small devices.

## 3. Check the charging port
Lint and dirt can block contact. With the device off, gently clear the port with a wooden toothpick or compressed air. Do not use metal tools.

## 4. Look at the lights
No light on charge may mean a dead battery or fault. See [indicator lights](/blog/understanding-vape-device-indicator-lights/).

## 5. Leave it for a while
Deeply discharged batteries may need a few minutes before showing any charging response.

## 6. Avoid heat and damage
Do not charge a device that is hot, swollen or damaged. Stop using it and follow [disposal guidance](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## 7. Not rechargeable?
Disposables without a charging port cannot be charged. See [rechargeable versus non-rechargeable](/blog/rechargeable-vs-non-rechargeable-disposables/).

## Care
Follow [battery care basics](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/). If faulty, contact support via the [contact page](/contact/) and check the [refund policy](/refunds/). Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I use a phone charger?
faq.a: Usually yes, if it supplies a standard 5V. If unsure, use the cable and a basic adapter.

faq.q: Why does it charge very slowly?
faq.a: A weak cable, port or adapter can slow charging.

title: How to Charge a Rechargeable Disposable Vape
summary: Type-C disposables can be topped up. Here is how to charge them properly and how to tell when they are full.
body:
Many modern disposables include a USB-C port, so you can recharge them and use the full amount of liquid.

## Check it is rechargeable
Look for a charging port at the bottom and a Type-C mention on the product page. If there is no port, the device is non-rechargeable. See [rechargeable versus non-rechargeable](/blog/rechargeable-vs-non-rechargeable-disposables/).

## What you need
A standard USB-C cable and a USB adapter or computer port. A basic 5V charger is best.

## How to charge
1. Plug the cable into the device and the other end into the adapter.
2. Check the indicator. Many show red or a pulsing light while charging.
3. Wait about 30 to 60 minutes, or until the light turns green or off.
4. Unplug and use.

## While charging
Place it on a hard, flat surface, not on a bed or sofa. Stay nearby and never leave it charging overnight.

## Do not use while charging
Unless the manual says pass-through is supported, wait until it is done.

## Extend battery life
Charge before the battery is fully empty and avoid heat. See [extending battery life](/blog/how-to-extend-vape-battery-life/).

## If it does not charge
Try another cable and adapter; see [vape will not charge](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/).

## Disposal
When the liquid is gone, recycle the device; see [disposal](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I overcharge a disposable?
faq.a: Many have protection circuits, but unplug it when done and avoid overnight charging.

faq.q: How often should I charge it?
faq.a: Whenever the battery indicator shows low, or when the device stops responding.

title: How to Make Your Vape Battery Last Longer
summary: Simple habits protect a lithium battery and give you more uses per charge. Follow these tips for longer life.
body:
Batteries age with every charge cycle, but you can slow it down.

## Avoid extremes of temperature
Leaving a device in a hot car or freezing outdoors reduces capacity. Keep it in a pocket at body temperature.

## Charge sensibly
Charge when it is low, rather than letting it run completely flat, and unplug when full.

## Use quality chargers
A decent cable and 5V adapter provide stable power.

## Lower the power
Higher wattage and boost modes drain batteries faster. Use the lowest setting that gives a satisfying draw.

## Take shorter puffs
Long, repeated puffs draw heavily on the battery and heat the coil.

## Keep it clean
Dirty contacts increase resistance and waste energy. Wipe them with a dry cotton bud.

## Store properly
If you will not use a device for weeks, store it at around half charge in a cool place.

## Replace worn batteries
Built-in batteries cannot be replaced, so when they fade, the device has reached end of life. Removable cells can be replaced with correctly rated ones. See [battery care basics](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## How batteries relate to puffs
See [mAh, puffs and battery life](/blog/mah-puffs-and-battery-life-how-they-relate/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Should I charge to 100%?
faq.a: It is fine for convenience, but long periods at 100% or 0% age batteries faster.

faq.q: Does vaping on boost drain faster?
faq.a: Yes. Higher power uses more energy per puff.

title: How to Prime a New Coil or Pod Before the First Puff
summary: A dry wick burns on the first puff. Priming a new coil takes two minutes and protects flavor and lifespan.
body:
Priming means soaking the wick in liquid before you use a new coil. Skipping it is the most common way to ruin one.

## Why prime
Cotton that is dry burns when heated, leaving a burnt taste that can shorten the coil's life. Soaking ensures the wick is saturated.

## Step by step
1. Drip a few drops of e-liquid directly onto the cotton through the wicking holes, if the coil has them.
2. Fill the tank or pod with liquid, up to the recommended line.
3. Let it stand for five to ten minutes.
4. Take two or three gentle puffs without pressing the fire button, if possible.
5. Start at a low power, then increase gradually.

## Pod systems
For refillable pods, fill the pod, let it rest, then draw gently. Do not overfill.

## Thick liquid
Thicker liquids need longer to soak. Wait up to fifteen minutes.

## Signs it is ready
The cotton looks dark and wet, and the first puffs taste like the liquid, not burnt.

## Prevent repeat damage
Keep liquid above the minimum and avoid chain vaping. See [why vape tastes burnt](/blog/vape-tastes-burnt/).

## Replace when needed
Check [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/) and browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Do disposables need priming?
faq.a: No. They are pre-primed by the manufacturer.

faq.q: What if I forget to prime?
faq.a: Stop using it if it tastes burnt. The coil may already be damaged.

title: How Often Should You Replace Your Vape Coil?
summary: A coil does not last forever. Learn the signs it is worn out and the typical lifespan for different liquids and power levels.
body:
Coils are consumable parts. How long they last depends on use, liquid and power.

## Typical lifespan
Most coils last between one and four weeks of regular use. Heavy users or those with sweet liquids may replace them more often, while light users may go longer.

## Signs it is time
- **Weak flavor:** taste fades even with fresh liquid.
- **Burnt taste:** persistent after priming and a fresh fill.
- **Reduced vapor:** thin or inconsistent clouds.
- **Gurgling or leaking:** worn coils can flood.
- **Dark, crusty residue:** visible on the coil head.

## What shortens a coil's life
Sweet, creamy or high-VG liquids, high wattage, chain vaping and not priming.

## What extends it
Prime it, use recommended wattage, take breaks between puffs and choose compatible liquids. See [priming a coil](/blog/how-to-prime-a-new-coil-or-pod/).

## Pods
For pod systems, replace the pod or coil as the manual states, often every one to two weeks.

## Do not clean coils
Rinsing a coil rarely restores it and can leave moisture. Replace instead.

## Keep a spare
Buy a spare pack so you are never stuck. See [how to pick replacements](/blog/how-to-pick-replacement-coils-and-pods/).

## Shop
Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How do I know the coil is worn?
faq.a: Weak flavor, burnt taste, gurgling or reduced vapor are the main signs.

faq.q: Can I extend coil life by lowering power?
faq.a: Yes. Lower wattage and compatible liquids help.

title: How to Clean a Vape Device: Tanks, Pods and Contacts
summary: Regular cleaning improves flavor and prevents leaks and poor connections. Here is a simple routine for tanks, pods and electrical contacts.
body:
A quick clean every week or two keeps a refillable device tasting good and working reliably.

## What you need
Warm water, a few drops of mild dish soap if needed, paper towels, a dry cotton bud and a small bowl. Never use alcohol on plastic parts, which can crack them.

## Clean the tank or pod
1. Remove the coil and any removable seals.
2. Rinse the tank or pod in warm water. A drop of dish soap helps with residue.
3. Rinse thoroughly and let it dry completely, ideally overnight.
4. Do not submerge the battery or any electronics.

## Wipe the contacts
Use a dry cotton bud to wipe the metal pins and the battery connector. Dirt here causes poor firing.

## Clean the mouthpiece
Rinse it with warm water or wipe it with a damp cloth. Dry it before refitting.

## Do not clean the coil
Replace worn coils instead; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## Reassemble
Fit seals, coil and tank when completely dry, then prime the new coil; see [priming](/blog/how-to-prime-a-new-coil-or-pod/).

## Prevent buildup
Avoid very sweet or thick liquids where possible, and fill carefully; see [filling a pod without leaks](/blog/how-to-fill-a-pod-without-leaks/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I wash the whole device?
faq.a: No. Only rinse the tank, pod and mouthpiece. Keep the battery dry.

faq.q: How often should I clean?
faq.a: Every week or two, or when you change flavors.

title: How to Store E-Liquid: Heat, Light and Child Safety
summary: Proper storage keeps flavor fresh and keeps liquid away from children and pets. Follow these simple rules.
body:
E-liquid is sensitive to heat, light and air, and it contains nicotine. Storing it well protects both quality and people.

## Keep it cool
Store in a cool place, ideally below 77°F (25°C). Do not leave bottles in cars, on windowsills or near radiators.

## Keep it dark
Light darkens liquid and degrades flavor. Keep bottles in their boxes or in a drawer.

## Seal tightly
Close caps firmly after each use. Oxygen speeds up aging.

## Keep upright
Store bottles upright to prevent cap leaks.

## Keep away from children and pets
Use a high, closed cabinet or a lockable box, and keep the original child-resistant cap on. See [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/).

## Do not transfer to food-style containers
Use labeled bottles made for e-liquid. Never use drink bottles.

## Travel

title: How to Store Disposable Vapes So They Stay Fresh
summary: Storing disposables correctly protects the battery and flavor, especially if you buy in bulk. Here is what to do.
body:
If you buy several disposables, how you store them affects how well they perform.

## Keep them cool and dry
A drawer or cabinet away from heat and humidity works best. Avoid cars, windowsills and bathrooms.

## Keep them upright when possible
This helps liquid sit where it should and prevents leaks around the mouthpiece.

## Protect the mouthpiece
Keep the cap or cover on if it has one, to keep out dust.

## Protect the battery
Lithium batteries dislike heat. Do not store them near radiators or direct sunlight. If a device is rechargeable, store it at roughly half charge for long periods.

## Avoid pressure on the button
Keep devices where nothing can press the fire button, such as at the bottom of a bag.

## Keep them away from children and pets
Treat them like any nicotine product; see [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/).

## Shelf life
Unused disposables generally keep well for months. Liquid and battery performance slowly decline over time, so rotate your stock.

## Bulk buying
If you buy many, store them in a cool box and use the oldest first. See [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/).

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How long does a disposable keep unused?
faq.a: Several months if stored cool and dry, though freshness slowly declines.

faq.q: Should I lay it flat?
faq.a: Upright is better for liquid placement, but short periods flat are fine.

title: How to Change a Pod or Coil in Three Easy Steps
summary: Swapping a pod or coil takes under two minutes. Follow these steps for a clean change without leaks or dry hits.
body:
Changing wear parts is routine. Here is how to do it neatly.

## Before you start
Turn the device off if it has a lock, and wipe the outside so no liquid drips into the battery. Have your new part and some liquid ready.

## Changing a closed pod
1. Pull the old pod straight out.
2. Push the new pod in until it clicks.
3. Wait a minute, then take a gentle puff.

## Changing a refillable pod coil
1. Remove the pod from the device.
2. Unscrew or pull out the old coil.
3. Install the new coil and tighten it gently, not too hard.
4. Prime the coil by dripping liquid on the cotton, then fill the pod. See [how to prime a coil](/blog/how-to-prime-a-new-coil-or-pod/).
5. Let it rest for five to ten minutes.

## Changing a tank coil
Unscrew the tank, remove the old coil with the supplied tool if needed, fit the new coil and fill with liquid after priming.

## Check compatibility
Use only coils listed for your device; see [how to pick replacements](/blog/how-to-pick-replacement-coils-and-pods/).

## Dispose of old parts
Put used coils and pods in your hazardous waste stream; see [disposal](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Shop
Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Do I need tools?
faq.a: Most pods click in. Some tank coils use a supplied tool or thread by hand.

faq.q: Why does my new coil taste burnt?
faq.a: It probably was not primed. Let it soak longer next time.

title: Vape Flavor Fading? How to Bring Back the Taste
summary: Weak flavor can come from taste fatigue, a worn coil, low battery or stale liquid. Try these fixes in order.
body:
If your favorite flavor tastes flat, one of a few things is going on.

## Taste fatigue (vaper's tongue)
Using one flavor constantly can dull your sense of it. Switch flavors for a few days, drink water and avoid heavily flavored foods. Rotation helps; see [best disposables for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/).

## A worn coil
Residue builds on coils over time and dulls flavor. Replace it; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## Low battery
Weak power makes weak vapor. Charge the device.

## Wrong power or airflow
Too much airflow dilutes flavor. Close it slightly or lower the wattage. See [adjustable airflow](/blog/adjustable-airflow-explained/).

## Old or poorly stored liquid
Heat and light degrade liquid. Check the date and storage; see [e-liquid shelf life](/blog/e-liquid-shelf-life-and-expiry/).

## Sweet liquid buildup
Sugary liquids leave residue. Clean the device and replace the coil. See [how to clean a vape](/blog/how-to-clean-a-vape-device/).

## Temperature
Cold liquid is thicker and wicks slowly. Let it warm up.

## Still faded?
Try a new flavor family, or a different brand. Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Why can't I taste my vape suddenly?
faq.a: Often taste fatigue or a worn coil. Take a break and replace worn parts.

faq.q: Will stronger nicotine improve flavor?
faq.a: No. Strength does not make flavor stronger.

title: What Is a Dry Hit and How Do You Avoid It?
summary: A dry hit is a harsh, burnt draw from a coil that is not wet enough. Learn why it happens and how to prevent it.
body:
A dry hit is the unpleasant, burnt taste you get when the coil heats while the wick is dry.

## What causes it
- **Low liquid:** the tank or pod is nearly empty.
- **Unprimed coil:** a new coil that was not soaked.
- **Chain vaping:** wick cannot re-saturate between puffs.
- **Wrong liquid:** too thick for the coil to wick.
- **Too much power:** burning liquid faster than it can be supplied.

## What to do after one
Stop. Check the liquid level and refill if needed. Let the wick soak for several minutes. If the burnt taste persists, replace the coil.

## How to prevent them
- Always prime new coils; see [priming](/blog/how-to-prime-a-new-coil-or-pod/).
- Keep liquid above the minimum.
- Pause between puffs.
- Use compatible liquid; see [PG and VG ratios](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).
- Stay within the coil's recommended power; see [ohms, watts and volts](/blog/what-are-ohms-watts-and-volts-in-vaping/).

## Why not to push through
A dry hit can be unpleasant and indicates stressed hardware.

## Disposables
Dry hits in disposables mean the device is empty or the wick is not saturated. When it happens, stop using it.

## Related
Read [why a vape tastes burnt](/blog/vape-tastes-burnt/). Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is a dry hit harmful?
faq.a: It is unpleasant and can irritate. Stop and fix the cause.

faq.q: Can I save a burnt coil?
faq.a: Rarely. Replacement is the reliable fix.

title: How to Fill a Refillable Pod Without Leaks
summary: Filling a pod cleanly is a skill. Follow these steps to avoid flooding, leaks and spills, and get a clean refill every time you top up your device.
body:
Refilling is simple once you learn a few habits.

## Prepare
Wash your hands and wipe the pod's exterior. Lay a paper towel under your work area. Use a bottle with a narrow tip.

## Find the fill port
Most pods have a silicone plug or a small fill hole. Open it and note the central tube. Never let liquid run into the tube.

## Fill slowly
Hold the pod upright and tilt the bottle slightly. Fill along the side wall slowly, stopping about a quarter inch below the top.

## Close and wait
Replace the plug fully, wipe off drips and let the pod rest five minutes so the wick can soak.

## Check the level
Never fill past the maximum line. Overfilling is the biggest cause of leaks; see [leaking causes](/blog/vape-leaking-causes-and-fixes/).

## Use the right liquid
Pods work best with salts and balanced ratios. See [PG and VG ratios](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/) and [salts versus freebase](/blog/nicotine-salts-vs-freebase/).

## Clean up
Wipe spills immediately with a paper towel and wash your hands. Keep liquid away from children and pets.

## Shop
Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How full should a pod be?
faq.a: Below the max line and never over the central tube.

faq.q: Why does my pod leak after filling?
faq.a: Overfilling or an unseated plug is the usual cause.

title: Vape Firing by Itself? Causes and What to Do
summary: A vape that activates without a puff can drain the battery and heat the coil. Here is how to find the cause and stop it.
body:
Self-firing is a nuisance and can be a sign of a fault. Take it seriously.

## Common causes
- **Moisture in the sensor:** condensation or e-liquid has reached the airflow sensor.
- **Debris in the airflow path:** lint or dust sticks.
- **A stuck button:** on button-fire devices, pocket pressure can hold it.
- **A damaged sensor:** physical damage or manufacturing defect.

## What to do
Stop using the device and remove the pod or tank. Hold it upright and let any moisture drain. Wipe the sensor area gently with a dry cotton bud and let it dry.

## Prevent moisture
Do not overfill, store upright and clean regularly. See [how to clean a vape](/blog/how-to-clean-a-vape-device/).

## Safety
If the device becomes hot, smells odd or lights flash rapidly, stop using it and let it cool. See [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Disposables
Disposables cannot be repaired. If self-firing continues, stop using it and dispose of it properly; see [disposal](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Contact support
If a new device fires by itself, tell us via the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID and check the [refund policy](/refunds/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is auto-firing dangerous?
faq.a: It can overheat the coil and drain the battery. Stop using the device until fixed.

faq.q: Can I fix it myself?
faq.a: Cleaning and drying sometimes works for refillable devices, but disposables cannot be repaired.

title: Vape Spitting or Hot Vapor? Fixes for a Harsh Draw
summary: Spitting and hot vapor point to flooding, too much power or a coil problem. Use these steps to restore a smooth draw.
body:
If your vape pops, spits droplets or feels hot, something is out of balance.

## Spitting
Droplets of liquid hitting your tongue usually mean the coil is flooded or the liquid is too thin for the airflow.
- Clear excess liquid by blowing through the mouthpiece.
- Open the airflow slightly.
- Check for overfilling; see [fill a pod without leaks](/blog/how-to-fill-a-pod-without-leaks/).

## Hot vapor
Warm to hot vapor can come from:
- **Too much power:** lower the wattage.
- **Chain vaping:** pause between puffs.
- **Tight airflow:** open it to cool the vapor.
- **A worn coil:** replace it; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## Wrong liquid
Very thin liquid in a high-airflow tank can spit, and thick liquid can overheat. See [PG and VG](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).

## Moisture in the airflow
Gurgling can cause popping. See [fixing gurgling](/blog/vape-gurgling-sound-fix/).

## Check the device
A device that is hot to the touch should be allowed to cool. If this recurs, stop using it. See [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) and [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Why does my vape pop?
faq.a: Liquid on the coil boils unevenly when flooded. Clear excess liquid and check the fill level.

faq.q: Can too much power cause hot vapor?
faq.a: Yes. Lower the wattage or open the airflow.

title: Nicotine Pouches for Adult Beginners: What They Are and How to Choose
summary: Tobacco-free nicotine pouches need no device and produce no vapor. Learn how they work, strengths, flavors and how to pick a first can.
body:
Nicotine pouches are small, discreet pouches placed between the lip and gum. They are popular with adults who want nicotine without a device, charging or vapor.

## How they work
A pouch contains nicotine, plant-based fibers, flavorings and other ingredients. When placed in the mouth, nicotine is absorbed through the lining. You do not chew or swallow it and there is nothing to spit. Remove it after the recommended time, typically 20 to 30 minutes.

## No tobacco leaf
Modern pouches are described as tobacco-free. They still contain nicotine, which is addictive, and they are for adults 21 and over.

## Choosing a strength
Strength is listed in mg per pouch. Lower strengths suit new users; higher ones suit experienced nicotine users. See [pouch strengths explained](/blog/nicotine-pouch-strengths-explained/).

## Choosing a flavor
Mint and menthol are the most common, followed by citrus, berry, coffee and cinnamon. See [pouch flavors](/blog/nicotine-pouch-flavors-guide/).

## Choosing a brand
Brands differ in size, moisture and flavor intensity. Our [brand comparison](/blog/nicotine-pouch-brands-compared/) covers the main names.

## Storage and etiquette
Keep cans cool and dry and away from children and pets. See [storing pouches](/blog/how-to-store-nicotine-pouches/).

## Shop
Browse [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Do pouches contain tobacco?
faq.a: They are marketed as tobacco-free, but contain nicotine.

faq.q: How long do I keep a pouch in?
faq.a: Follow the pack instructions, typically up to about 30 minutes.

title: Nicotine Pouch Strengths Explained: 3 mg, 6 mg and Beyond
summary: Pouch strength is printed in milligrams per pouch. Learn what the numbers mean and how adults can choose a level.
body:
Unlike vape liquid, pouch strength is a fixed dose per pouch, so the numbers are straightforward.

## What mg per pouch means
A 6 mg pouch contains six milligrams of nicotine. How much your body absorbs depends on how long it stays in and your usage.

## Typical strength tiers
- **Low (1.5 to 3 mg):** milder, common for first-time users.
- **Medium (4 to 6 mg):** the usual middle range.
- **High (8 to 12 mg):** stronger products for experienced users.
- **Extra strong (13 mg and above):** the strongest cans.
Brands name tiers differently, so check each label.

## Strength is not flavor
A strong pouch can have a mild flavor, and a mint pouch can be low-strength. They are separate.

## How to choose
Start lower if you are new to nicotine, or match what you currently use if you are experienced. Nicotine is addictive, and increasing your intake is not advisable for everyone. This is not medical advice.

## Reading a can
Strength appears on the lid or side, with the number of pouches per can and the warning statement. See [what the nicotine warning label means](/blog/what-the-nicotine-warning-label-means/).

## Compare brands
See [pouch brands compared](/blog/nicotine-pouch-brands-compared/).

## Shop
Browse [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is a higher strength better?
faq.a: No. It is simply a larger dose per pouch.

faq.q: Can I cut a pouch?
faq.a: Not recommended. Use them as intended and follow pack instructions.

title: How to Use a Nicotine Pouch: Step-by-Step for First-Time Users
summary: Using a pouch is simple but easy to get wrong. Here is how to place, time and dispose of one properly.
body:
Nicotine pouches are easy once you know the basics.

## Step 1: wash your hands
Clean hands keep the pouch hygienic.

## Step 2: place the pouch
Put the pouch between your upper lip and gum, usually on one side. Some people prefer the lower lip. Avoid pressing it too hard.

## Step 3: wait
You may feel a tingling or warmth as nicotine releases. Keep it in for the time in the instructions, generally up to about 30 minutes.

## Step 4: remove and dispose
Take the pouch out and throw it in a bin. Do not flush it or leave it on the ground. Many cans have a built-in disposal slot.

## Tips
- Do not chew or swallow the pouch.
- Drink water if your mouth feels dry.
- Do not use more than one pouch at a time unless the instructions allow it.
- Start with a lower strength; see [strengths explained](/blog/nicotine-pouch-strengths-explained/).

## If you feel unwell
Remove the pouch and rinse your mouth. If you feel faint or sick, stop using and seek advice. Nicotine is addictive; this is not medical advice.

## Etiquette and travel
See [pouch etiquette and travel](/blog/nicotine-pouch-etiquette-and-travel/).

## Storage
See [how to store pouches](/blog/how-to-store-nicotine-pouches/).

## Shop
Browse [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Where do I put the pouch?
faq.a: Between the upper lip and gum, or the lower lip, following the pack instructions.

faq.a: No. Keep it in place and do not swallow it.

If you buy several cans, keep the extras sealed in a cool cupboard. Rotate stock; see [bulk buying](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/).

Keep pouches in their original can, which has child-resistant features and warnings.

Dispose of used pouches in the trash, never on the ground or flushed.

Carry a can in a pocket, not loose pouches. See [pouch etiquette and travel](/blog/nicotine-pouch-etiquette-and-travel/).

title: How Many Pouches Are in a Can, and How Long Does a Can Last?
summary: A typical can holds about 15 to 20 pouches. See how usage affects how long a can lasts and how to compare value across brands.
body:
Cans differ between brands, so check each product page.

## Pouch counts
Most cans contain between 15 and 20 pouches, with some holding more. The count is printed on the lid and listed in our product descriptions.

## How long a can lasts
That depends entirely on how many you use. One pouch a day makes a can last about two to three weeks. Several a day make it last far less time.

Divide the price by the pouch count to get cost per pouch. A $6 can of 20 is 30 cents each, and a $4 can of 15 is about 27 cents. Include strength when comparing.

title: What Is Nixodine? A Plain-English Explainer
summary: Nixodine is a newer ingredient sold in some vapes as an alternative to traditional nicotine. Here is what we can and cannot say about it.
body:
You will see "Nixodine" on a growing number of disposable vapes and liquids. It is marketed as a nicotine alternative, so a few plain facts help.

## What the term means
Brands use "Nixodine" for a nicotine-alternative active ingredient used in their e-liquid. Different manufacturers may describe and source it differently, so what is in one product may not match another. Always read the label and the brand's own information.

## Why it is sold
Some adults look for alternatives to traditional nicotine for personal or regulatory reasons, and brands offer these products to meet that interest. Our [Nixodine range](/shop/nixodine/) groups them in one place.

## What we do not claim
We make no health claims about Nixodine or any product, and regulatory treatment of newer ingredients can change, so always check the label and your local rules. Do not assume anything about a product's effects or addictiveness from the name of its ingredient.

## How it is used
Nixodine products are used like other vapes: inhale from a disposable, pod or tank device. See [how a vape works](/blog/how-does-a-vape-work/).

## Questions to ask
- What exactly is the active ingredient?
- What strength is it listed at?
- What warnings are on the label?
- Is it allowed where I live? See [state and local laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Learn more
Compare with traditional nicotine in [Nixodine vs nicotine](/blog/nixodine-vs-nicotine-guide/). Adults 21+ only.

title: Adult Vaper Etiquette: Using Devices Considerately
summary: Courtesy and responsibility matter. Here are simple etiquette tips for using vapes in public, at home and around others.
body:
Responsible adult use starts with consideration for others.

## Know the rules first
Many places restrict vaping, including workplaces, transit, restaurants and parks. See [state and local vape laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Ask before you vape indoors
In someone's home, ask permission, and respect a no.

## Keep clouds to yourself
Large clouds can bother people nearby. Lower your power or step away from groups. See [cloud chasing vs flavor chasing](/blog/cloud-chasing-vs-flavor-chasing/).

## Dispose responsibly
Do not litter used devices, pods or pouches. See [disposal](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Keep products away from minors
Never provide vapes to anyone under 21 and store them securely. See [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/).

## Be careful with batteries
Keep devices out of bags where they can be pressed, and charge them attended. See [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Be honest about nicotine
Nicotine is addictive. If you want advice on nicotine use, consult a healthcare professional.

## Travel considerately
Follow airline and local rules; see [traveling with vapes](/blog/traveling-with-vapes-airline-rules/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

title: Crypto Payment FAQ: Fast Answers Before You Pay
summary: Which coins, which networks, how long it takes and what to do if something goes wrong. Quick answers about paying with crypto.
body:
Short answers to the questions we hear most about crypto payments.

## Which coins do you accept?
Bitcoin, USDT (Ethereum ERC20 and Tron TRC20), USDC (Solana), Ethereum, BNB (BNB Smart Chain) and Solana.

## Is there a discount?
Yes, 10% off the product subtotal. See [how the discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Where do I find the address?
In the payment window after you choose Cryptocurrency at checkout, with a QR code and copy buttons. See [scanning the QR code](/blog/scan-wallet-qr-code-and-copy-address/).

## How is my payment detected?
Automatically on most networks. See [how we detect payments](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

## Which network should I choose?
The one shown in the window. Read [what a crypto network is](/blog/what-is-a-crypto-network/).

## I do not own crypto. What now?
You can buy it with a card. See [how to buy crypto with a card](/blog/how-to-buy-crypto-with-a-card/).

## What if I used the wrong network?
Contact us immediately. See [wrong-network steps](/blog/sent-crypto-on-the-wrong-network/).

## What if the payment looks short?
See [underpaid messages](/blog/why-your-crypto-payment-shows-underpaid/).

## Do I pay network fees?
Yes, to the network, not to us. See [fees explained](/blog/crypto-network-fees-explained/).

## Browse
See [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

title: How to Use Your Private Order and Payment Page
summary: Your order link opens a private page with payment details, tap-to-copy fields and a receipt uploader. Here is what each part does.
body:
After you order, a private page tracks everything about your order. It needs no account, only the link in your email.

## Opening the page
Use the link in your confirmation or payment email. The link includes a unique token, so keep it to yourself.

## The summary
At the top you see your order ID, the amount due and the current status. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Payment details
For Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, each detail appears in its own box with a tap-to-copy button. For crypto, you see the wallet address, network and amount, plus an automatic status checker. For gift cards, you see the buy link and steps.

## Uploading proof
Use the upload box to add screenshots, receipt photos or gift card photos. You can add a transaction hash or card code and a note. See [uploading proof](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## The WhatsApp link
A button opens WhatsApp with a message about your order if you prefer chat.

## If the page says "not found"
The link may be incomplete. Copy the whole link from the email, including the part after the question mark. Or contact us via the [contact page](/contact/).

## Privacy
Do not share the link. Only people with it can view the order. Read about [privacy](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/).

## Related
Start with [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Do I need an account?
faq.a: No. Your private link is enough.

faq.q: Can I bookmark the page?
faq.a: Yes. Bookmark the full link to return later.
